title: Becoming Limitless
coreMove: Demote an old learning label from identity to a process that can be trained.
sourcePressure: The memoir-origin chapter: a childhood brain injury, shame around learning, and the first turn from a felt limit into trainable capability.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating the opener as inspirational origin-story uplift instead of a diagnostic split between wound, label, and method.

sourceAnchors.name: Jim Kwik
sourceAnchors.detail: The frozen source support identifies his childhood brain injury and later learning struggle as central to the opening chapter.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The point starts with a boy who learned to read difficulty as identity before he had any reason to trust method.

sourceAnchors.name: comic-book and superhero fascination
sourceAnchors.detail: The sidecar allows superhero fascination only as contrast between felt limitation and imagined possibility, not as decorative nostalgia.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The superhero image matters because it makes the distance between felt limitation and imagined possibility visible.

sourceAnchorNote: Frozen sidecar gives one real named figure anchor: Jim Kwik and his childhood learning struggle. No other precise named people, dates, studies, places, or quoted scenes are authorized.

hook: Do not open Becoming Limitless with a generic unlocked potential claim.
Do not start with a definition of becoming limitless.
counterintuition: Do not use a not X but Y correction shell.
Do not claim the opposite of common sense in generic coaching language.
tryThisNow: Do not use set a timer and reflect.
Do not ask the reader to journal broadly without a visible action.
examples: No repeated desk, kitchen, classroom, commute, or generic meeting shells.
No six examples built around timestamp plus named protagonist plus decision.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm, using a question to the reader, a research aside only if source-supported, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference

skillTargets: Identify when demote an old learning label from identity to a process that can be trained. is needed in a new scenario.
